WITH signed_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CASE type
            WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END AS signed_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
), account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM signed_transactions
    GROUP BY account_id
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT
    aa.account_id,
    aa.average_amount,
    aa.average_amount - om.mean_average AS above_mean
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE aa.average_amount > om.mean_average
ORDER BY above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The mean is taken over accounts with at least one PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction; accounts with no qualifying transactions have no per-account average and are excluded.
